content.text:
Links inside link text no longer produce nested `` elements. `[foo [bar](/uri)](/uri)` now gives `

[foo bar](/uri)

`. All 1781 spec tests pass, and so do all 44 in `test/unit/marked.test.js`. **Cause:** the `outputLink` helper in `src/Tokenizer.ts` built a link token without checking whether its text already contained a link. **Fix:** `outputLink` now rejects a link token whose inner tokens contain a link, at any depth. The outer `[` then falls through as literal text and the inner link is kept. Images are unaffected, so a link inside image alt text still works. **Reference-style case:** `[foo [bar](/uri)][ref]` now gives `

[foo bar]ref

`. That is the expected output for CommonMark example 532, so it differs from the output shown in the bug report. **Spec files:** examples 518, 519 and 532 were marked `shouldFail` in `test/specs/commonmark/commonmark.0.31.2.json` and `test/specs/gfm/commonmark.0.31.2.json`. I removed those flags, since they now pass. Saving those files with `JSON.stringify` also reformatted some lines beyond the three flags (15 insertions and 13 deletions across the three changed files, the fix included). I didn't add a separate unit test; the three spec examples now cover this. I didn't run `tsc` because that command was denied, so the type change is unchecked beyond the esbuild build succeeding.
